title: Orbit Gobbler
summary: A support-free, all-printable hand-cranked desk automaton whose captive cratered moon retracts into a cheerful one-eyed creature, completes a clearly exposed geared orbit, and pops back through a fixed C-shaped mouth every two crank turns.
manufacturing_process: FDM 3D printing with 0.4 mm nozzle; all parts print without supports in their declared orientations.
limitations: Digital CAD inspection does not prove a successful physical print, fit, friction, cycle life, durability, child safety, or user response.
Clearances are parameterized starting values for PLA or PETG and require physical fit coupons before production claims.
Operate slowly while holding the base; the crank, moon, bezel, frame keys, and snap clips are not carry handles.
